title: 3.0 RC1 MDT unable to Scan for Rileylink
symptom: After removing the current RileyLink, scanning for a second RileyLink fails. The user had to import settings to get it running again.
cause: The issue was identified as a permission issue with Android 12.
fix: The fix was implemented in a commit: https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/commit/e2bdc348349e6894c05eb0ba9809e378e10cb9d1
evidence_quote: This might be permission issue you talked to me about @MilosKozak with Android 12.
